title: Nail 35B-A3B IQ3_XXS on one RTX 5060 Ti 16GB
purpose: Single-card 131K high-context MoE route on the explicitly non-thinking request path with q8 KV and built-in MTP.
caveats: The Nail project's live canonical deployment uses the dual-GPU Q4_K_XL preset; this IQ3_XXS single-card preset is an alternative high-context route.
This preset is validated on the explicitly non-thinking request route (thinking disabled at the request level). Thinking-enabled behaviour requires separate evidence.
The retry receipt directly establishes ~115.4K-token retrieval and ~91.8K-token sustained generation; active/effective server-context metadata was not exposed by the endpoint.
131K is the configured profile tier here, not a maximum-context claim.
